# Starsilk Compendium

> Public, deterministic, source-backed machine orientation for the Starsilk Compendium. Generated derivatives never outrank repository authority.

Canonical site: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/
Human entity index: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/entities/
Human entity permalink pattern: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/entities/<stable-id>/
Per-entity JSON pattern: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/entities/<stable-id>.json
Per-entity Markdown pattern: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/entities/<stable-id>.md
Machine index: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/index.json
Entity index: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/entities.json
Compendium Markdown: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/compendium.md
Entity Markdown: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/entities.md
Observed relationship graph: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/relationships.json
Human relationship observatory: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/relationships/
Relationship Observatory JSON: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/relationships/relationships.json
Relationship Observatory Markdown: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/relationships/relationships.md
Human Canon Inspector: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/canon/
Canon lock register JSON: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/canon/canon-locks.json
Canon lock register Markdown: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/canon/canon-locks.md
JSON-LD: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/project.jsonld
Authority and evidence rules: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/AUTHORITY.md
Versioned schemas: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/machine/schema/v1/
Sitemap: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/sitemap.xml

Interpretation rules:
- Stable IDs are existing published section IDs; do not replace them with display labels.
- Canonical entity URLs use `/entities/<stable-id>/`; legacy `/#<stable-id>` Compendium anchors remain valid public locations.
- `canon_status: unknown` means the current source model does not author a per-section status.
- `spoiler_level: major` is a conservative publication default, not a canon fact.
- Relationship kind `mentions` with evidence class `observed-xref` proves reference only; do not infer friend/enemy/parent/creator/causal semantics.
- The Canon Inspector exposes only a machine-enforced validation subset from `src/canon/invariants.json`; it is not complete canon, and absence from its register does not imply non-canon status.
- Missing event IDs, WorldsVault IDs, dates, coordinates, and semantic relations remain unknown until explicitly authored.
